title: Average US billion-dollar weather disasters per year

source.name: Billion-Dollar Weather and Climate Disasters
source.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)

notes: CPI-adjusted annual averages: 2.8 events/year in the 1980s, 5.2/year in the 1990s, climbing to 20.4/year from 2019-2023.
